positions.title: Resource Director
positions.description:
Managed and led short term medical/dental mission teams to Trinidad, Haiti, Peru, Cambodia, Senegal, Bangladesh.

Improved inventory management of medical supplies used for short term missions while decreasing man-hour need by 88%. (Google Drive, Google Apps Script)

Developed WordPress theme from ground up for use by MCO Augusta as well as expansion campuses without technology-savvy resource directors. (HTML, PHP, CSS, WordPress)

Managed basic rental property repair needs including washing machine repair, sink faucet replacements, diagnosing and replacement of television logic board, electronic door lock installation, furniture repair, WiFi access point upgrades, audio/video upgrades including installation of a projector and sound system, other handy-man style tasks. 

Solved IT and basic technology issues for First Pres Augusta Outreach ministry staff. Outreach ministries include Hope for Augusta, Campus Outreach Augusta, City Hope Alliance, and MCO Augusta. (Google Drive/Sheets, Excel, Mac OS, Windows, iOS, WordPress)

Created graphics, logos, and marketing materials for distribution to MCO leadership (staff) and students. (Autodesk Graphic, Pixelmator)

positions.title: IT director
positions.description:
Maintained system architecture while learning basic requirements for Windows based domain controllers and file servers. 

Repaired damaged hardware including restarting and repairing network after ice storm power surge, diagnosing and repairing power supply burnout on a PC, solving simple IT issues including printer malfunctions and connectivity issues.
